name: Water Style: Water Dragon Bullet Jutsu
desc: A column of water rises and twists into a roaring serpent that lunges at the target with crushing weight.
tip: Canon uses 44 seals; this is the opening eight. Keep a steady rhythm, like reciting a long chant.

name: Water Style: Water Shark Bomb Jutsu
desc: Gathered water takes the shape of a hungry shark that races forward and bursts on impact.
tip: Canon has ten seals including a clone seal; this is the seven-seal order from the detector project. Snap the final Ram like you are releasing the shark.

name: Water Style: Water Prison Jutsu
desc: A sphere of dense water seals the target inside; the caster keeps one hand in it to hold the cage shut.
tip: Finish by pressing both palms together, then imagine holding a heavy ball of water.

name: Water Style: Collision Destruction
desc: The caster spews out a staggering mass of water that turns dry land into open sea, then drives the swell into the enemy.
tip: Canon uses a single Snake; Dragon and Mizunoe are added here. Push both hands outward on the last sign.

name: Hidden Mist Jutsu
desc: Chakra-laced fog rolls in until the battlefield is a white blank, perfect for a silent approach.
tip: Ox, Snake, Ram, then hold Ram still while the fog thickens.

name: Water Style: Water Fang Bullet
desc: Water underfoot spirals into drill-like fangs that spring up and stab inward.
tip: Canon is a lone Tiger; this app uses three signs. Hold Snake low, as if lifting water from the ground.

name: Earth Style: Mud Wall
desc: Mud spat onto the ground swells into a thick earthen wall that stops attacks cold.
tip: Slam the last sign down as if pressing a hand to the ground.

name: Earth Style: Earth Dragon Bullet
desc: The ground heaves up into a rocky dragon head that spits a volley of mud bullets.
tip: Three signs ending on Dragon; lean forward as the dragon head rises.

name: Earth Style: Earth Flow Spears
desc: Sharp stone spikes burst out of the earth in a line, skewering whatever stands above them.
tip: Snake, Rat, Bird; keep each sign crisp so Rat is not read as Snake.

name: Earth Style: Swamp of the Underworld
desc: Solid ground turns into a deep bog that drags anything standing on it down into the mud.
tip: Just Boar then Tiger. Hold Tiger and press downward as the ground softens.

name: Wood Style: Wood Dragon Jutsu
desc: A colossal dragon of living timber coils out of the ground and binds its prey while sapping its chakra.
tip: Canon order minus the final technique-specific seal.

name: Wood Style: Four-Pillar Prison Jutsu
desc: Wooden pillars shoot up around the target and lock together into a sturdy cage.
tip: Ram, Ox, Boar, Snake; hold Snake while the pillars close in.

name: Secret Jutsu: Demonic Mirroring Ice Crystals
desc: Panes of ice form a ring of mirrors; the caster darts between them faster than the eye can follow.
tip: Canon uses one technique-specific seal; this app assigns four. Start on Mizunoe and end on a sharp Bird.

name: Certain-Kill Ice Spears
desc: Moisture in the air freezes into a bristling ring of ice spikes that close in on the target.
tip: No canon seals are known; this app uses Mizunoe, Hare, Bird. Flick your fingers outward at the end.

name: Sand Coffin
desc: Sand pours over the target and hardens into a tight shell, pinning them completely.
tip: Gaara needs no seals; close your hand into a fist after the last sign.

name: Shield of Sand
desc: Sand rises on its own to block any attack, forming a curved barrier before the caster even reacts.
tip: Gaara's sand moves on its own; these three signs are the app's trigger. Raise one arm as the wall forms.

name: Storm Style: Laser Circus
desc: Beams of crackling storm chakra fire from the hands and bend through the air to chase their targets.
tip: Five signs ending on Dragon, then spread your fingers to fire the beams.
